location_fine: dry grassy hillside in the countryside
character_types: city man in white shirt and tie
visual_synopsis: After opening landscape shots of hills and a snow-capped mountain, an excited man in a white shirt and tie runs across a dry grassy field to a mustachioed village man in a flat cap sitting on a rock with his tan dog. The two trade animated close-up monologues about the dog before the city man runs off across the field again.
